profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Interacting with clients for understanding requirements and providing solutions.
Architecting and developing applications. 
Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly.

Programming Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, XAML, T-SQL, XML, HTML.

Technologies: React, Redux, three.js, AngulasJS, Angular, UWP, .NET, .NET Core, 
Microsoft Azure: Cosmos DB, SQL Server, App Services, Web Apps; Azure DevOps, Windows Presentation Foundation, Silverlight, Windows Phone, WinRT, Xbox 360, Xbox One, WCF, LINQ, SQL Services Reporting Services, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, Windows Forms, Web Services.

Tools: Microsoft Visual Studio, Microsoft Visual Studio Code, SQL Server Management Studio, Microsoft Expression Blend, Git, Team Foundation Server.
